claims.assertion: Yazhi rejected skin color as evidence of extraterrestrial lineage, saying starseed identity can occur across human pigmentation groups and describing pigmentation as solar adaptation.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: She said human-looking offworld visitors can blend into populations and go unrecognized because they do not match popular alien stereotypes.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She said Latin-looking visitors were numerous.

claims.assertion: Yazhi claimed an old Sphinx image showed two entrances near its paws, now covered, and said the ground in the image looked false.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: These are her claims about the image and her memory.

review_flags: Racial and archaeological claims are attributed to Yazhi and are not established findings.
coverage_gaps: Her claims about hidden subterranean sites and energy resources
